page.overview:
Who is Amphicoelias?

is an extinct genus of sauropod dinosaur that lived in Colorado, United States during the Late Jurassic period. It has been known to be the largest dinosaur ever (before the discovery of large titanosaurs such as Patagotitan) by a single piece of vertebrae that has been discovered by paleontologist Edward Drinker Cope. However the specific species of Amphicoelias that has these gigantic size estimates, A. fragillimus has been reclassified to , and only the smaller 15 metric ton A. altus is the only remaining valid species of this genus.

Amphicoelias was illustrated by Timothy Bradley in the Dinopedia section of Jurassic Park Institute, but hasn't received a dino card before its closure in 2006. However, it would receive a dino card in the website Dinosaur Earth on Dinopedia.
